notes.title: Prepare for Guardians of Gaia
notes.content:
The wait is almost over, Guardians of Gaia is nearly here!
We’re gearing up for launch with a wave of awesome updates:

[list]
[*] New Weapon: Unleash the power of the Hana Shield.
[*] Smoother, Flashier Battles: Animations and effects have been polished to a shine.
[*] Better Than Ever: Performance boosts and quality-of-life upgrades across the board.
[/list]
The full adventure is just around the corner — we can’t wait for you to jump in!

notes.title: Spring Update
notes.content:
Merged changed from the main game. It is getting quite close to being finished, so this is a lot more representative. It's taken quite a while so thanks for staying patient.

[list]
[*] Vulkan Engine support for Intel Iris.
[*] New Shop Items.
	1. Dango: replenish health.
	2. Raito: lightning katana.
[*] Weapon durability has been made more forgivable. Shields as always have great durability.
	1. Small durability damage on environmental impacts.
	2. Large durability damage on guarding attacks.
	3, Normal durability damage on having an attack guarded.
	4. Half durability damage on landing an attack.
[*] Poise damage has been increased, thus easier to perform a "Guard Break".
[*] Larger window for inputs, especially on jump attacks. It should be much easier to pull off combos,
[*] All round performance improvements.
[*] General bug fixes and quality improvements.
[/list]

Please look forward to the main game. It's not far off now!

notes.title: Autumn Update
notes.content:
Added fixes and changes from main game. Final push with only debugging and polish remaining. Thanks for your patience and please look forward to it.

[list]
[*] Gameplay
 1. New animations.
 2. Balancing and improved combat.
 3. Chain explosions support, where explosive affect surrounding flammable material.
 4. Cancel weapon throw is now on shoulder buttons.

[*] Graphics
 1. New procedural sky rendering.
 2. New Effects.
 3. Vulkan full-screen exclusive support.
 4. Vulkan memory paging support.
 5. Subtle UI tweaks,
 6. Optimized Steam deck settings.

[*] Audio
 1. Upgraded weapon audio

[/list]

tags.feature: 3. Chain explosions support, where explosive affect surrounding flammable material.
4. Cancel weapon throw is now on shoulder buttons.

notes.title: Spring Update
notes.content:
Gearing up for the launch of the main game! In the meantime I have merged some of the changes.

[olist]
[*] Weapons that are planted horizontally can now be used as a Spring board. Not many uses in the prologue, but a useful mechanic in the main game.
[*] Plunge attack is now on alternate attack button. Before, it would automatically execute a plunge attack at height. This just allows the choice between standard attacks and plunge attack at height.
[*] Improved refraction shaders. 
[*] Threading performance improvements. 
[*] General quality of life and bug fixes.
[/olist]

tags.feature: [*] Weapons that are planted horizontally can now be used as a Spring board. Not many uses in the prologue, but a useful mechanic in the main game.

[*] Plunge attack is now on alternate attack button. Before, it would automatically execute a plunge attack at height. This just allows the choice between standard attacks and plunge attack at height.
